injections.rationale: In the mixture-of-experts update each expert E_i is applied to the projected input W_E x. The injected form applies E_i to the projection matrix W_E and then right-multiplies by x, which is structurally similar but not the same operator: the expert now acts on a matrix rather than on the projected feature vector, and the result no longer matches the architecture the surrounding text describes. Perturbs the existing equation in place.
injections.ground_truth_description: MoE update: expert application changed from E_i(W_E x) to E_i(W_E) x, so the expert acts on the projection matrix instead of the projected input.
